captions.detailed: This 3D model is a desktop business card holder featuring an angled, wedge-like body with rounded corners. The front face is tilted backward to naturally present the cards, and it features a deep, angled slot running along its length to securely support cards. The bottom surface includes a recessed area designed to accept dual-color embossed logo inserts.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric business card holder with an angled front face and rounded corners. The holder should include a deep rectangular slot angled at 30 degrees for holding cards, and a recessed bottom area to accommodate a dual-color imported image surface logo, with adjustable parameters for card dimensions, holder size, and corner radius.
captions.factory: The script constructs the main body by unioning two rounded-corner blocks (created using overlapping cubes and cylinders at the corners) and rotating the upper block by -26 degrees. A boolean difference operation is used to slice off the bottom of this angled block, and a second difference operation cuts out the card slot using an angled cube. Finally, a two-part logo recess is subtracted from the bottom face using the surface() function to load external image data scaled to the specified heights.
